content: Root cause: The bug was caused by incorrect handling of the offset for GPIO pins 32 and above, which spill over into the next 32-bit register. The original implementation did not adjust the offset when calculating the register address, leading to an incorrect bitmask that overflowed and resulted in no action being performed for those pins. The fix involved modifying the function to correctly update the offset by passing it as a pointer, allowing the function to adjust the offset when it exceeds the number of pins per register.
